Nina: Quick pulse check on the perf cycle docs I uploaded an FAQ and the final review templates to Drive. Need managers to ACK by Fri 06/04.
Omar: where's the FAQ?
Nina: /drive/PeopleOps/PerfCycle_2026/FAQ_Manager.pdf and Review_Template_v3.docx
Lily: what are the hard dates again?
Nina: review window: 06/10 - 06/21. Calibration week: 06/24 - 06/28. Appeals window: 07/01 - 07/08.
Sasha: small ask can we add a checkbox for completed 1:1 evidence review? makes it easier to track.
Nina: done added to the form.
Omar: managers OOO?
Nina: interim reviewer process: if manager out >72h, People Ops will assign interim. Use interim text in FAQ.
Lily: ACK from me.
Sasha: ACK.
HR-bot: Reminder: Missing forms will get auto-reminders at 48h and 12h before close.
Nina: any objections to collecting calibration slides this year?
Omar: optional but helpful.
Lily: prefer optional.
Sasha: optional.
Nina: ok keeping optional. Recording of manager Q&A will be uploaded.
Lily: ACK.
